name: ALADIA PVP
desc:
🔥🔫 Welcome to Aladia PVP –  Inspired by FiveM🔫🔥
⚠️ This is a NEW GAME! While we've worked hard to bring you an epic PVP experience, you may encounter some bugs we're constantly improving! Your feedback helps us make the game even better!

💥 Fast-Paced Gunfights | Custom Skins | Unique Maps | Intense Action 💥

🎮 Master the Controls & Dominate the Battlefield!
🕹 Move – W, A, S, D
🏃 Sprint – Shift
🔼 Jump/Roll – Space
🦾 Crouch – C
🎒 Inventory – F2 / V

📦 Inventory Tips:
⚡ Drag & Drop items to Use or Give
🔢 Assign weapons & gear to slots 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

🎯 Why Play Aladia PVP?
🌍 Dynamic Maps – Fight across diverse, strategic battlegrounds!
🛠 Custom Skins – Show off your unique style!
💣 Fast-Paced Combat – Skill, strategy, and reflexes matter!

⭐ Support & Stay Updated!
🔹 LIKE & FAVORITE to keep the updates coming!
🔹 REPORT BUGS – Help us improve & get better!
🔹 FOLLOW the Developer for future content & special rewards!
